referenceFunction.generalComment: The module roughly describes the net electricity production of an average 300 MW plant for the country, assumed as average for the entire coal power plant park. As modelled for Europen hard coal power plants within ecoinvent, the plant is assumed to be used for middle load with 4000 hours of operation at full capacity per year. The plant is assumed to operate 150000 hours during its lifetime. For the main characteristics (LHV, sulphur and ash content of coal, efficiency of the plant) and key criteria emissions (SOx and particles), direct information from individual Shandong power plants in 1998 and 1999 from the CETP project (Dones, Zhou and Tian 2003) has been used. These base data have been integrated for other species as well as trace elements and radionuclides using maximum data from European plants (see corresponding meta-information). The waste heat releases to air and water have been allocated on the basis of the assumed share of water cooled power plants and assumptions on the direct losses to air as for European plants (no data available specific to China). The share of the recycled ash and the disposal of the remaining ash are assumed the same as for Poland (lack of information specific to China).; UUID: 02850375-8380-36a7-a0fd-f68d5e9aab45
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: Electricity output at busbar. The module uses an average net efficiency of Chinese small coal power plants at coal mines at the end of the 1990s (nearly 13%).
